# mcp/tests/fixtures/l43_l37_attempt-2.json

## Governing Overview

[Owning route](../overview.md)

## Purpose

Preserve the portable closed L37 attempt-2 rows used by the recorded-meaning regression.

## Code Commentary

This is a bounded historical subset, not the complete owner history or a live knowledge tree. It retains invariant effects/own revisions and the old family row without effect or own revision: ROW-DQN7HY (clarify), ROW-KY2EJG (weaken), ROW-N46VKD (effect not recorded).

The backend test files it into its isolated fixture tree with the correct owner/attempt path. Historical rows are not backfilled from present family/member revisions. Keep the bytes as evidence; update the consumer/witness deliberately rather than silently rewriting the old judgment.
